verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own SDK, with sync and async clients for application code, and an SDK-based tracing integration for LiveKit agents, so some official instrumentation exists. The evidence never names a language for the SDK and shows no JS/TS SDK; the npx command installs AI-assistant skills, not an instrumentation SDK. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official Python SDK, any evidence of an official JS/TS SDK, general (non-LiveKit) tracing instrumentation docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs
